info.name: Cyware Intel Exchange (CTIX) v3 Open Quick Add Intel API

items.docs:
Creates an IOC parsing task to extract STIX objects from free text data or a web page.

Currently, this API endpoint does not support parsing IOCs from files such as PDF, CSV, XLS, and others.

items.docs: Returns a list of country codes based on the [STIX 2.1 enumeration](https://docs.oasis-open.org/cti/stix/v2.1/csprd01/stix-v2.1-csprd01.html#:~:text=bit%20x86%20architecture.-,10.20%20%E2%80%8BRegion%20Vocabulary,-Vocabulary%20Name:%20region).
